name: Gaussian Voxel Kernel Functions (GVKF)
definition: A method for efficient and effective 3D surface reconstruction in open scenes that establishes a continuous scene representation based on discrete 3DGS through kernel regression, integrating fast 3DGS rasterization with implicit scene representations.
summary: Gaussian Voxel Kernel Functions enable efficient 3D surface reconstruction by replacing discrete splats with continuous kernel regression, reducing memory usage and allowing direct mesh extraction.
